title_en: Ljuba Began to Sing in the Garden
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Ко ќе иди' is read as 'when he/she comes', and the snake's wish as 'let me bite', my reading. 'отворено' (open) is rendered as 'unattended'.

lines.en: Ljuba began to sing from the garden

lines.cyr: да ја чуе Науме во планина.
lines.lat: da ja čue Naume vo planina.
lines.en: so that Naum on the mountain would hear her.
When Naum heard her on the mountain,
Beside the flock, a colorful flute,
from the flute a snake spoke:

lines.cyr: Ко ќе иди Науме од планина,
lines.lat: Ko ḱe idi Naume od planina,
lines.en: When Naum comes down from the mountain,

lines.cyr: да го каснам Науме за раката.
lines.lat: da go kasnam Naume za rakata.
lines.en: let me bite Naum on the hand.

lines.cyr: Ко ќе иди Љуба од градина,
lines.lat: Ko ḱe idi Ljuba od gradina,
lines.en: When Ljuba comes from the garden,

lines.cyr: да ја каснам Љуба за ногата.
lines.lat: da ja kasnam Ljuba za nogata.
lines.en: let me bite Ljuba on the foot.
